summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the prioritized UI/UX fixes. Covers accessible semantic risk colors (Emerald, Amber, Crimson), responsive mobile hamburger navigation, full WCAG accessibility (aria-labels and visible focus rings), collapsing developer controls into a dedicated Demo/Debug drawer, dual-state history views (responsive mobile cards and desktop table), dual-state empty filters, flexible currency handling, accessible dialog management (Escape-to-close), and human-friendly plain language.
